current.text: He is a rookie. The 76ers drafted him 22nd overall in the 2026 NBA Draft.
He comes off the bench behind Tyrese Maxey and VJ Edgecombe in a crowded Philadelphia guard rotation.
Nick Nurse gives his starters and guards very heavy minutes, so few minutes are left for a rookie guard.
Experts see no big role for him in Philadelphia this season. One calls his path to minutes almost impossible.
In Summer League he played with restraint on 28% usage. He averaged 6 assists and 1.5 steals but shot 26% from three and 63% from the line.
Over the long term he could become a 27-minute player in about two years or be traded into a starting role. This is a dynasty view and does not help this season.

durable.text: Experts rated him a top 10 prospect before the draft. They expect him to become a good shooter and possibly a better player than Jared McCain.
